output.reason: Several weeks of intermittent post-fatty-meal right upper abdominal pain without reported fever or jaundice fits a pattern needing clinician assessment and likely gallbladder imaging, but nothing reported requires emergency or same-day hands-on care.
output.patientMessage: Start a message review with a Counsel clinician in this thread about your recurring right upper belly pain after fatty meals; this pattern often needs a gallbladder ultrasound the clinician can arrange. Meanwhile, smaller low-fat meals may reduce episodes. Seek emergency care now if pain lasts more than a few hours, becomes severe or constant, or you develop fever, chills, vomiting, or yellowing of your eyes or skin.
